ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70-75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominating the central and lower regions, with 25-30% high-intensity (white) pixels localized along the distal tips and trailing edges.

Smaller, fragmented high-intensity mottling on the distal left lobe. Solid low-intensity black core across the center and fluke base.
